concerns.text: FR-014 mandates stratified splitting by `material_pair_id` only. If a single material appears in multiple pairings, that material can be present in both training and test sets, causing data leakage and potentially inflating R² scores. The split should also enforce that no individual material identifier appears in both sets (e.g., leave‑one‑material‑out or grouping on both constituent material IDs).

SC-004 requires at least three features to have mean absolute SHAP values that are statistically significant (p < 0.05) via a permutation‑test. SHAP values are derived from the fitted model; testing their significance on the same data used to train the model constitutes double‑dipping and does not provide a valid inference about true feature importance. A more appropriate approach would be to assess feature importance on held‑out data or via nested cross‑validation.
